# Divyansh Sood® Studio

> Independent web design & development studio run by Divyansh Sood. We build custom-coded, conversion-focused websites, online stores and web apps for businesses across India and worldwide — strategy, interface and engineering under one roof. Typical sites go live in about 14 days.

Divyansh Sood is a web designer and developer based in Himachal Pradesh, India, working with clients globally. Every project is custom-coded (no page-builder templates) and starts from how customers actually make decisions — then design and engineering follow. The studio handles strategy, UX/UI design, front-end and full-stack development, e-commerce, SEO and ongoing growth.

- Founder: Divyansh Sood (Web Designer & Developer)
- Location: Himachal Pradesh, India — available worldwide
- Established: 2024
- Positioning: custom-coded, conversion-focused, fast delivery (≈14 days)
- Stacks: React, Next.js, Astro, Angular, Tailwind, Supabase, Razorpay, headless CMS

## Services

- **Strategy & Research**: Customer-journey audit, drop-off analysis, and a clear path from first click to conversion — grounded in real behaviour.
- **Design & Prototyping**: High-fidelity interface design and clickable prototypes before any code is written — typography, motion, states.
- **Development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly front-ends and full-stack builds — React, Next.js, Astro, Angular or headless.
- **Support & Growth**: Ongoing iteration once live — A/B tests, new pages, performance tuning and monthly reporting.
- **SEO / AEO / GEO**: Technical and on-page SEO from day one — clean markup, fast loads, structured data, llms.txt, and content built to rank and be quoted by AI answer engines.

## Selected work

- [WebSeek.ai](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/webseek): AI website generator — one prompt to a working, custom-coded site in any language, paired with Claude, GPT and Gemini. Live beta, 5 free credits per user.
- [InHimalayas](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/inhimalayas): Revenue-share travel booking platform tuned for global travellers, with llms.txt + GEO built in. Saw a measurable lift in AI-referred traffic post-launch.
- [Dharamshala Tours](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/dharamshala-tours): WhatsApp-first travel booking site for a Kangra operator. Part of ~1,000 packages booked every month.
- [Redline Studios](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/redline): Brand identity + F1-styled Razorpay storefront for a motorcycle-apparel label. Built end-to-end in one sprint.
- [ChinkiZ Knitting Knife](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/chinkiz): Custom-coded D2C storefront for a 600K+ subscriber YouTuber, with a native video gallery and admin panel — no Shopify.
- [Modern K.B.S.](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/modernkbs): School website + admissions admin panel delivered in 7 days where other agencies quoted 6 months.
- [Nandini Travels](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/nandini): Next.js rebuild for Kangra's most-reviewed taxi operator — direct bookings now flow through the site instead of Google Maps.
- [North Peak Power Systems](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/northpeak): 15-page Angular site + project gallery + dashboard-cum-admin for a Himachal solar/electrical contractor breaking into the private sector.

## FAQ

- **Do you write the copy, or do we?** Either works — conversion-focused copy written for you, or polishing what you provide. Most projects are a collaboration.
- **What happens after launch?** A tidy handover, documentation, and 30 days of free support, with an optional ongoing retainer.
- **How long does a project take?** A focused landing page runs 3–4 weeks; a full site 6–10. A limited number of projects are taken on at once.
- **What if I'm not happy with the result?** Work runs in clear milestones with revision rounds; nothing ships until you're genuinely happy.
